# Sundown Safaris, full trip detail

Private Kenya safaris from Nairobi run by Sundown Capital Limited, trading as Sundown Safaris. Every trip uses a private 4x4 Land Cruiser and guide for one group only. Prices are starting prices per person in US dollars. Peak season dates (July to October) and holidays quote higher because park fees and lodge rates rise. Every journey can be adjusted around the guest's dates.

Book or ask: bookings@sundownsafari.com or WhatsApp +254 724 491 210. Draft itinerary and price within 24 hours. 50 percent deposit to confirm, balance 60 days before travel, quotes held for 30 days.

## The Explorer, 3 Day Adventure, from US$1,700 per person

URL: https://www.sundownsafari.com/trip/3-day-a-adventure-the-explorer.html

Where: Masai Mara and conservancy land. Active tracking on foot and off the main roads.

Day by day:

1. Arrival and evening game drive
2. Full day deep field tracking
3. Morning drive and departure

Included: Private 4x4 Land Cruiser with pop up roof; Certified field guide and tracker; All Masai Mara park and conservancy fees; 2 nights eco lodge accommodation; Full board meals; Airport/airstrip transfers; Bush walk with armed ranger.

Not included: International flights; Travel insurance; Gratuities and tips; Personal expenses; Visa fees.
